# Third-party notices

winx86's own code (everything not listed below) is Copyright (c) 2026 Franck
Roustan and is licensed MIT — see `LICENSE`. This file lists the third-party

## Box86 (dynarec core) — `third_party/box86-dynarec/`

Copyright (c) 2018-2021 Sebastien Chevalier ("ptitSeb").
License: MIT (full text in `third_party/box86-dynarec/LICENSE`).
Upstream: https://github.com/ptitSeb/box86

`third_party/box86-dynarec/` is a verbatim extraction of Box86's ARMv7 dynarec
core (see `tools/extract_box86.sh`) plus a local patch set applied on top
(`tools/box86_local_patches.diff`, generated and mechanically validated by
`tools/regen_box86_patch.sh` — never hand-edited). The patches (fastmmu,
memintrin, emitprof, signtag, the scheduler preemption seam, the SMC
write-protection switch) are original work by the winx86 author and are
MIT-licensed under the same terms as the rest of this repository; they are
intended to be upstreamable to Box86 itself.

## `vita_kb_font.h` — `src/platform/vita_kb_font.h`

Copyright (c) 2026 Franck Roustan. MIT-licensed (see `LICENSE`), but the
pixel data is a reproducible render of **DejaVu Sans Mono**
(Bitstream Vera / DejaVu license — free use and redistribution), 8x16
1-bit-per-pixel glyphs for printable ASCII 32-126. No font file is embedded;
this header is a generated product (regenerated by d2vita's
`tools/kb_font_gen.py`, which stays in the downstream consumer repo for now)
of that free font, not a copy of the font itself. See
https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/ for the DejaVu project and its license terms.
